NY02-0757 DECLARATIONOFZONINGLOTRESTRICTIONS THE CITY OF NEW YORK, a municipal corporation with an office at City Hall, New York, New York (hereinafter referred to as the “City"), ADDABBO REHC LLC, a limited liability company with its principal place of business at c/o Joseph P. Addabbo Family Health Center, Inc., 67-10 Rockaway Beach Boulevard, Arverne, New York 11692 (hereinafter referred to as the “Developer"), and the NEW YORK CITY ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION, a local developmental corporation organized pursuant to Section 1411 of the New York State Not-for-Profit Corporation Law, having its principal office at 1l0 William Street, NewYork, NewYork 10038 (hereinafter referred to as“EDC"), constituting the“parties in interest" as defined in Section 12-10(d) of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York TenTative.lor effective December 15, 1961, as amended, with respect to land known as Tax Lots 1 and 70 in 入 Block 16015 on the Tax Map of the City and State of New York, County of Queens, do hereby declare that the tract of land known as and by the street address 6200 Beach Channel Drive, Queens, New York, is to be treated as one zoning lot for the purpose of and in accordance with the provisions of the aforementioned Zoning Resolution effective December 15, 1961, as amended. The said parcels of land are respectively described on Exhibit A annexed hereto, and comprise tax lots which are contiguous for more than ten (1o) linear feet with tax lots respectively adjacent thereto. The said tax lots are located within a single block.
